articles.headline: FIFA to investigate violent clash beween Spain and Argentina after World Cup final
articles.description: FIFA has opened a disciplinary investigation into the ugly scenes which marred the end of Sunday's World Cup involving several Argentina players and coaches physically attacking members of the Spain team.

articles.headline: Stargazing: Inside the last days of Spain's quest for a second World Cup
articles.description: There was something in the air as Spain prepared for the World Cup final. No, not the smoke of Canadian wildfires, but a certain inevitability.

articles.headline: Lionel Messi thanks Argentina, says pain from loss 'immense'
articles.description: Argentina star Lionel Messi sent a heartfelt thank-you to his fans on Monday, one day after the defending champions fell to Spain 1-0 in extra time at the World Cup final in New Jersey.

articles.headline: Which World Cup records are most likely to be broken in 2026?
articles.description: The latest World Cup presents an opportunity to make history, and North America's expanded tournament this summer could be one to rewrite the record books.

articles.headline: Spain World Cup champions return home for a royal welcome, parade
articles.description: Spain's World Cup-winning team returned home on Monday, where the 26-man squad is due to meet with Spain's royals and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.

articles.headline: Not even Messi's magic could will Argentina to back-to-back World Cups
articles.description: Argentina were well beaten by Spain in the 2026 World Cup final, but the defending champions were also battling against history in New Jersey.
